meta_description: CC Decorating in Bristol offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating and wallpapering. Free quotes and reliable local service.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free quotes, no pressure, same-day site visits available.
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, we handle all your painting and decorating needs with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room refreshes, feature walls, and bespoke colour schemes. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof masonry and woodwork protection. We work in all conditions and guarantee a finish that looks fresh for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern matching, difficult corners, and textured finishes. We remove old paper carefully and hang new coverings without bubbles or seams.

services.title: Woodwork Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and fitted furniture painted to a hard-wearing finish. Colour-matched or custom stains available.

services.title: Prep & Surface Work
services.desc: Proper preparation is everything. We fill, sand, prime, and seal to ensure your new paint or paper adheres perfectly and looks professional.

services.title: Specialist Coatings
services.desc: Damp-resistant paints, anti-mould finishes, and specialist exterior coatings for challenging locations and problem areas.

about_pullquote: Good preparation and honest pricing — that's how I've built my reputation in Bristol.
about_para_1: CC Decorating was founded on the simple belief that decorating should be reliable, fairly priced, and hassle-free. For over 15 years, we've been helping Bristol homeowners refresh their spaces — from small bedroom updates to complete house repaints. We've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time, and it shows in the repeat work and referrals we receive.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and willingness to get prep work right, even when it adds time to the job. We don't cut corners or use cheap materials. Every quote is transparent, and we'll explain exactly what's involved before we pick up a brush. That's why customers come back and recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About CC Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge done — walls, woodwork, the lot. Craig was really professional, turned up on time, and didn't make a mess. The finish is flawless. Definitely using him again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. Got a quote within two days, price was fair, and the work was done faster than expected without rushing it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Had some damp issues on the external wall and wasn't sure what to do. Craig explained the specialist paint needed and applied it properly. Six months on, no problems at all.
reviews.author: Michael R.

address_sub: Serving Kingswood, South Bristol, and surrounding areas

footer_description: CC Decorating is a trusted painter and decorator based in Kingswood, Bristol. We specialise in interior and exterior decorating, wallpapering, and specialist coatings.
